notes: Waits for the card's re-verification (its record changed on 2026-11-12): played on the record, as `cardtool runpack M20 <pack>` plays it. Printed: 'When this creature enters, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, destroy target creature an opponent controls.' The opponent controls no creature. The enters trigger has no target (the card's ruling: 'goes on the stack without a target'), so it goes on the stack and offers the sacrifice: 'fire' sacrifices the Fodder (a choice its controller may want, a dies trigger say); the reflexive trigger then has no legal target and is removed (CR 603.12, 603.3d). Before, the enters trigger chose that target itself and, with none legal, was removed as it went on the stack: no sacrifice was offered.
